sources.facts: Rock Rings 3D: two independent units with flexible single-point suspension, 184 × 146 × 57 mm and 1.9 kg per set.
sources.notEstablished: No dimensioned reverse cross-section, mouth widths, passage path or nominal chemistry.

sources.tier: manufacturer numbered hold guide; visually inspected 1000 × 1000
sources.facts: Numbered guide identifies 1 jug, 2 40 mm four-finger pocket, 3 32 mm three-finger pocket, 4 25 mm two-finger pocket. Shows tapered silhouette, upper ears, rounded jug and successively smaller lower recesses.
sources.notEstablished: Guide is a manufacturer CAD illustration rather than metrology. Does not resolve hidden cord passage routing or rear geometry.

sources.facts: Original photograph corroborates the three front recesses plus jug. Two top cord exits on each unit, small light-transmitting hole through the upper-pocket back, resin swirl pattern.
sources.notEstablished: Hidden cord tunnels, rear profile and depth of small bore are not photographed. Swirl texture rights were not established.

sources.facts: Text calls material polyester resin, mentions suspension holes running deeper, and describes four-finger flat edge / three-finger pocket labels that differ from current primary guide.
sources.notEstablished: No measured routing diagram or proof of same hold-label convention.

sources.facts: Calls material polyurethane, in conflict with retailer polyester-resin description. Metric envelope agrees.
sources.notEstablished: Exact resin chemistry is not independently tested.

sources.publisher: Owner resale photograph hosted on eBay image CDN
sources.facts: Front and full reverse of black/white Rock Rings 3D. Rear has no central through-hole; rounded rear perimeter. Top cord exits and side access can be seen.
sources.notEstablished: Exact production year and calibration; matching molded shape does not prove every historical batch is identical.

sources.facts: Large oval lateral access opening with cord visible inside. Shows side-wall thickness and rounded rear edge.
sources.notEstablished: Hidden path, exact opening dimensions, cross-sectional factory drawing.

conflicts.conflict: Retailers call lower pockets 4-finger flat and 3-finger versus primary numbered 3-finger and 2-finger.
conflicts.ruling: Use current manufacturer numbered guide: eight physical contacts for the pair; no duplicate contacts from different finger-count terminology.

conflicts.conflict: Polyester versus polyurethane in retailer material listings.
conflicts.ruling: Use neutral resin PBR approximation; exact polymer is recorded unknown, not arbitrarily selected.

conflicts.conflict: Single-point suspension wording but two photographed exits per unit.
conflicts.ruling: Single point describes the overhead attachment. Preserve two ordered unit-associated exit markers per unit; do not collapse them to one board opening or invent the overhead cord junction.

conflicts.conflict: Some inch parentheticals imply 63.5 mm depth, whereas metric values state 57 mm.
conflicts.ruling: Use the consistent 57 mm metric manufacturer envelope.

conflicts.conflict: Earlier model inferred a small central front-to-rear bore from a low-resolution bright spot. Full rear shows uninterrupted resin.
conflicts.ruling: Remove the unsupported central bore; retain observed lateral cord-access windows. Owner evidence supports a matching exterior, not all possible molding revisions.
